delivery_modes.label: IAICT-hosted shared SaaS
delivery_modes.isolation: Multiple customer tenants; membership, MatterACL and RLS enforce separate data

delivery_modes.label: Dedicated deployment for a customer organization (private cloud/on-premises or isolated environment)
delivery_modes.provider_operation: Customer or agreed operator under deployment contract
delivery_modes.isolation: Isolated application environment, dedicated data/storage/secrets; existing tenant and MatterACL controls remain in force

shared_invariants: Same application source and versioned database migrations for both delivery modes; no permanent product fork.
Shared legal AI workflows, IAM authorization semantics, SRS APIs, audit semantics and negative tests.
Authentication provider, storage and external AI dependencies are explicit environment configuration; do not embed IAICT SaaS credentials in a customer installation.
No implicit IAICT operator or customer tenant-admin read of a MatterACL-protected case.
Customer/user/tenant names and JWT/header values never bypass verified membership and ACL.
No production or customer legal data until independent security/legal and Owner release acceptance.
implementation_targets: R0 bounded deployment-mode config and separation contract
Shared application packaging/migration path with distinct environment settings
Isolated dedicated test environment with genuine login and authorization
Run one representative R0 end-to-end legal workflow in each mode, then entire R0 acceptance matrix
Backup/restore, upgrade/rollback, secret isolation, logging and operational acceptance by Owner
